highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 updates the bundled renderer to Skia m153.
highlights_body: Linux font fallback can now select a different fontconfig face; use an explicit family, style, or bundled typeface when exact selection matters.

bullets.detail: Aligns the bundled renderer with Chrome milestone 153 and incorporates upstream m153 bug fixes.
Font fallback now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort path, which can select a different face and change text metrics or glyphs for applications that rely on fontconfig fallback.

preview_summaries.v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6: Preview 1 opened the 4.153 line with the Skia m153 engine update and its upstream fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2: Release Candidate 1 finalized the 4.153 preview line for broader validation before the stable release.
